data.body:
LANDED: Gerrit change 1364 MERGED as 0d1c92a1027ebf0470c3690d127f3cf65ce1a37c on main (patch set 4: LLM-Review +1, Verified +1, 0 unresolved).

Gate iteration trail, for the record:
- PS1 Verified -1: docs/env-vars.md is a DERIVED registry recording the binding_store.py os.environ.get line number, which the extraction shifted (127->107). Fixed by scripts/gen_env_registry.py regeneration, amended into the change.
- PS1/PS2 LLM-Review -1 (bugfix-size-attestation): a bug-fix touching >150 non-test lines requires a certified plan-review attestation. Cured by rebar review-plan (verdict PASS; first sign attempt hit a transient store-read-failure, re-signed via rebar sign-review) + rebar set-file-impact scoping the attestation to the 4 touched files (the unscoped attestation went stale-head on any store movement).
- PS3: a same-tree amend got the -1 vote-COPIED (changekind:NO_CODE_CHANGE) and the review bot refused recheck-review (real finding, not coverage gap). PS4 carried a one-word comment change to produce a real changekind; review re-ran: PASS (+1), CI SUCCESS (+1).

FINAL STATE (all 6 ACs met, boxes flipped): binding_store.py 699 LOC (<700), peer_state.py 135 LOC (>100); public surface unchanged, reconciler suites pass untouched (2189 unit + 36 integration); peer_state directly unit-tested without a BindingStore (13 new tests) incl. absence-semantics pins (absent baseline -> local-wins, absent peer parent -> NO clear); _BASELINE_FIELDS moved with the cluster, consumer census recorded above; module-size gate green in CI.

RESIDUAL GAPS dispositioned:
- tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/state/test_ref_lock.py::test_ac0_blob_ref_roundtrips_through_remote fails locally on this host (git cat-file 128 in a scratch bare repo) — fails IDENTICALLY on pristine origin/main, environment-specific, and the same suite is green in CI on change 1364. Disposition: accepted (pre-existing, not introduced or touched by this change; CI is the authoritative runner and is green).
- None otherwise observed.
